1.s_dismas: Abraham remoued from thence into the ſouth countrie, and dwelt betwene Cades, and Sur: and he liued as a pilgrime in Gerara.
1.odr_com: ABRAHAM remoued from thence into the south countrie, and dwelt betwene Cades, and Sur: and he liued as a pilgrime in Gerara.
1.sabates_a: Abraham removed from thence into the south country and dwelt between Cades, and Sur: and he lived as a pilgrim in Gerara.
1.madueke_b: Abraham removed from thence into the south country and dwelt between Cades, and Sur: and he lived as a pilgrim in Gerara.

2.s_dismas: And he ſaid of Sara his wife: She is my ſiſter. Abimelech therfore the king of Gerara ſent, and tooke her.
2.odr_com: And he said of Sara his wife: She is my sister. Abimelech therfore the king of Gerara sent, and tooke her.
2.sabates_a: And he said of Sara his wife: She is my sister. Abimelech therefore, the king of Gerara, sent and took her.
2.madueke_b: And he said of Sara his wife: She is my sister. Abimelech therefore, the king of Gerara, sent and took her.

3.s_dismas: And God came to Abimelech in a dreame by night, and ſaid to him: Loe thou ſhalt dye for the woman that thou haſt taken: for ſhe hath a huſband.
3.odr_com: And God came to Abimelech in a dreame by night, and said to him: Loe thou shalt dye for the woman that thou hast taken: for she hath a husband.
3.sabates_a: And God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him: Lo thou shalt die for the woman that thou hast taken: for she hath a husband.
3.madueke_b: And God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him: Lo thou shalt die for the woman that thou hast taken: for she hath a husband.

4.s_dismas: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he ſaid: Lord wilt thou kil a nation that is ignorant and iuſt?
4.odr_com: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said: Lord wilt thou kil a nation that is ignorant and iust?
4.sabates_a: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said: Lord wilt thou kill a Nation that is ignorant & just?
4.madueke_b: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said: Lord wilt thou kill a Nation that is ignorant & just?

5.s_dismas: Did not he ſay to me: She is my ſiſter: and ſhe ſay, He is my brother? in ſimplicitie of my hart, and cleanenes of my hands haue I done this.
5.odr_com: Did not he say to me: She is my sister: and she say, He is my brother? in simplicitie of my hart, and cleanenes of my hands haue I done this.
5.sabates_a: Did not he say to me: She is my sister? And she say, He is my brother? In simplicity of my heart and cleanness of my hands have I done this.
5.madueke_b: Did not he say to me: She is my sister? And she say, He is my brother? In simplicity of my heart and cleanness of my hands have I done this.

6.s_dismas: And God ſaid to him: And I do know that thou dideſt it with a ſincere hart: and therfore I kept thee that thou ſhouldeſt not ſinne againſt me, and I permitted not that thou ſhouldeſt touch her.
6.odr_com: And God said to him: And I do know that thou didest it with a sincere hart: and therfore I kept thee that thou shouldest not sinne against me, and I permitted not that thou shouldest touch her.
6.sabates_a: And God said to him: And I do know that thou didst it with a sincere heart: and therefore I kept thee that thou shouldest not sin against me, and I permitted not that thou shouldest touch her.
6.madueke_b: And God said to him: And I do know that thou didst it with a sincere heart: and therefore I kept thee that thou shouldest not sin against me, and I permitted not that thou shouldest touch her.

7.s_dismas: Now therfore reſtore the wife to her huſband, becauſe he is a prophet: and he ſhal pray for thee, and thou ſhalt liue: but if thou wilt not reſtore her, know thou that dying thou ſhalt dye, thou and al things that are thine.
7.odr_com: Now therfore restore the wife to her husband, because he is a prophet: and he shal pray for thee, and thou shalt liue: but if thou wilt not restore her, know thou that dying thou shalt dye, thou and al things that are thine.
7.sabates_a: Now therefore restore the wife to her husband, because he is a Prophet: and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live. But if thou wilt not restore her, know thou that dying thou shalt die, thou and all things that are thine.
7.madueke_b: Now therefore restore the wife to her husband, because he is a Prophet: and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live. But if thou wilt not restore her, know thou that dying thou shalt die, thou and all things that are thine.

8.s_dismas: And Abimelech forthwith riſing vp in the night, called al his ſeruantes: and he ſpake al theſe words to their eares, and al the men were ſore afraid.
8.odr_com: And Abimelech forthwith rising vp in the night, called al his seruantes: and he spake al these words to their eares, and al the men were sore afraid.
8.sabates_a: And Abimelech forthwith rising up in the night, called all his servants: and he spake all these words to their ears, and all the men were sore afraid.
8.madueke_b: And Abimelech forthwith rising up in the night, called all his servants: and he spake all these words to their ears, and all the men were sore afraid.

9.s_dismas: And Abimelech called alſo for Abraham, and ſaid to him: What haſt thou done to vs? what haue we offended againſt thee, that thou haſt brought vpon me and vpon my kingdom a great ſinne? that which thou oughteſt not to doe, thou haſt done to vs.
9.odr_com: And Abimelech called also for Abraham, and said to him: What hast thou done to vs? what haue we offended against thee, that thou hast brought vpon me and vpon my kingdom a great sinne? that which thou oughtest not to doe, thou hast done to vs.
9.sabates_a: And Abimelech called also for Abraham, & said to him: What hast thou done to us? What have we offended against thee, that thou hast brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? That which thou oughtest not to do, thou hast done to us.
9.madueke_b: And Abimelech called also for Abraham, & said to him: What hast thou done to us? What have we offended against thee, that thou hast brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? That which thou oughtest not to do, thou hast done to us.

10.odr_com: And again expostulating, he said: What sawest thou, that thou didest this?

13.odr_com: And after that God brought me out of my fathers house, I said to her: This mercie thou shalt doe with me: In euerie place, which we shal come vnto, thou shalt say that I am thy brother.

janvier_by_verse.3: And God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him: Lo thou shalt die for the woman that thou hast taken: for she hath a husband.
janvier_by_verse.4: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he said: Lord wilt thou kill a Nation that is ignorant & just?
janvier_by_verse.5: Did not he say to me: She is my sister? And she say, He is my brother? In simplicity of my heart and cleanness of my hands have I done this.
janvier_by_verse.6: And God said to him: And I do know that thou didst it with a sincere heart: and therefore I kept thee that thou shouldest not sin against me, and I permitted not that thou shouldest touch her.
janvier_by_verse.7: Now therefore restore the wife to her husband, because he is a Prophet: and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live. But if thou wilt not restore her, know thou that dying thou shalt die, thou and all things that are thine.
janvier_by_verse.8: And Abimelech forthwith rising up in the night, called all his servants: and he spake all these words to their ears, and all the men were sore afraid.
janvier_by_verse.9: And Abimelech called also for Abraham, & said to him: What hast thou done to us? What have we offended against thee, that thou hast brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin? That which thou oughtest not to do, thou hast done to us.
janvier_by_verse.10: And again expostulating, he said: What sawest thou, that thou didest this?
janvier_by_verse.11: Abraham answered: I thought with myself, saying: Perhaps there is not the fear of God in this place, & they will kill me for my wife:
janvier_by_verse.12: howbeit otherwise also in very deed she is my sister, the daughter of my father, & not the daughter of my mother, & I took her to wife.
janvier_by_verse.13: And after that God brought me out of my father's house, I said to her: This mercy thou shalt do with me: In every place which we shall come unto, thou shalt say that I am thy brother.
janvier_by_verse.14: Therefore Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and servants, and handmaids, and gave to Abraham: and restored to him Sara his wife,
janvier_by_verse.15: and said: The land is before you, dwell wheresoever it shalt please thee.
janvier_by_verse.16: And to Sara he said: Behold I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver, this shall serve thee for a veil of thine eyes to all that are with thee, and whithersoever thou shalt go, remember also thou wast taken.
janvier_by_verse.17: And Abraham praying, God healed Abimelech and his wife, and his handmaids, and they bare children:
janvier_by_verse.18: for our Lord had closed up every matrice of the house of Abimelech for Sara Abraham's wife.
